Hi Alice / Finanta security team,

Thanks for taking the time today — quick recap from our side and a proposed evidence path so we can keep momentum toward procurement. Key pain points we heard:
- Audit log retention minimums (you mentioned 7 years for transaction logs; 3 years for admin events).
- Need for continuous, immutable audit trail export (S3 + tenant-scoped index).
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and a high-level pen-test summary for security review.
- Data residency requirement (US-East for payments; EU for EU customers).

Goals we discussed:
- Confirm Redwood can provide redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a pen-test summary within 5 business days.
- Provide an audit-log retention matrix and export options for compliance.
- Align on a DPA draft and timeline for signature.

Immediate asks (can you confirm these are the items you want to receive?):
1) SOC 2 Type II report (redacted)
2) Pen-test executive summary (scope, date, remediation status)
3) Audit log retention/export spec (CSV mapping of event types and retention periods)
4) Draft DPA + notes on any additional clauses required by Finanta

I've attached a short questionnaire that will help us map our artifacts to your controls: SOC2-questions.xlsx (quick rows for audit-log types, retention buckets, and data residency). If you prefer, Marissa can run a compliance mapping session with your team next week.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm the four artifacts above and attach any internal templates (e.g., your DPA redlines).
- We deliver a first bundle of artifacts by EOD next Wednesday (26 Aug).
- If anything is urgent, let me know and we'll prioritize the SOC 2 summary first.

Thanks — looking forward to making this as frictionless as possible.

Best,
